entries.name: cthreshold-256-children-reject#0
entries.description: CTHRESHOLD(1, 256 × TrueProp) (98 01 80 02 d3…). The children are read first, then CTHRESHOLD's require (0 <= k <= n <= 255, SigmaBoolean.scala:223) fails: an IllegalArgumentException, and the JVM rejects.

entries.name: cthreshold-255-children-accept#1
entries.description: The twin: CTHRESHOLD(1, 255 × TrueProp). Round-trip identity.

entries.name: cthreshold-k-above-n-reject#2
entries.description: CTHRESHOLD(2, [TrueProp]) (98 02 01 d3): k above the number of children fails the same require: the JVM rejects.

entries.name: cand-no-children-accept#3
entries.description: CAND() (96 00): the parser builds CAND(children) directly, and that constructor carries no check (only CAND.normalized requires a non-empty list, SigmaBoolean.scala:165), so the JVM parses it. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: cor-no-children-accept#4
entries.description: COR() (97 00): parses, as CAND(). Round-trip identity.

entries.name: cthreshold-k-zero-accept#5
entries.description: CTHRESHOLD(0, [TrueProp]) (98 00 01 d3): k = 0 passes the require. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: cand-256-children-accept#7
entries.description: CAND(256 × TrueProp) (96 80 02 d3…). CAND's child count is a getUShort and the constructor checks nothing (SigmaBoolean.scala:80-86, :149), so up to 65535 children parse. Round-trip identity. An impl that bounds CAND at 255 children, as CTHRESHOLD is bounded, rejects it: the over-reject.

entries.name: cor-256-children-accept#8
entries.description: COR(256 × TrueProp) (97 80 02 d3…): it parses, as CAND does (:87-93, :185). Round-trip identity.

entries.name: cthreshold-k-256-reject#9
entries.description: CTHRESHOLD(256, [TrueProp]) (98 80 02 01 d3). k is a getUShort, 256, and the require (k <= n, SigmaBoolean.scala:223) fails: the JVM rejects. An impl that reads k as a byte gets 0 and accepts CTHRESHOLD(0, [TrueProp]): the over-accept.

entries.name: cthreshold-k-wraps-accept#10
entries.description: CTHRESHOLD whose k is written as 2^32 + 1 (8180808010), over [TrueProp]. scorex-util's getUShort is getULong().toInt and only then the 0..65535 check, so k reads as 1: CTHRESHOLD(1, [TrueProp]), written back as 98 01 01 d3. NON-IDENTITY. An impl that range-checks the full value rejects it: the over-reject.

entries.name: cand-count-wraps-accept#11
entries.description: CAND whose child count is written as 2^32 + 1 (8180808010): it reads as 1, CAND([TrueProp]), written back as 96 01 d3. NON-IDENTITY.

entries.name: cand-count-wraps-to-65536-reject#12
entries.description: CAND whose child count is written as 2^32 + 2^16 (8080848010): truncated to 32 bits it is 65536, which getUShort's check refuses: the JVM rejects before reading a child. An impl that keeps the low 16 bits reads 0 and accepts CAND(): the over-accept.
